_comment: The manual knob. Everything this skill does is driven by this file. Change model ids, transport, and response density here; never edit the doctrine to change a setting.

response._comment: Governs how much is said, never how much is covered. See references/density.md. Session overrides: `route.py density terse|default|full`.

levels.terse: The answer and nothing else. Reasons only where omitting one would mislead.
levels.default: The answer, plus one line of why for each non-obvious call.
levels.full: No compression. For teaching, debugging, and design discussion.

cheap.label: Luna
cheap.role: Clear, bounded implementation where approach, area, and validation are already known.

mid.label: Terra
mid.role: Repo-specific investigation, impact analysis, choosing among existing patterns, bounded-subsystem implementation.

main.label: Opus
main.role: Owns the request. Architecture, ambiguity, correctness-sensitive reasoning, routing, final review.

gates._comment: Handoffs cost tokens and context. These thresholds decide when a switch pays for itself. 'remaining' is the agent's estimate of remaining discrete steps (edits, files, checks) in the CURRENT scope.

policy._comment: allow_nested_spawn lets mid spawn cheap directly instead of returning to main first. Off by default: flat routing keeps one writer and one auditable ledger. See references/transports.md before enabling.

codex-cli._comment: Separate Claude and Codex accounts. Opus (Claude Code) shells out to the Codex CLI, which shares the same working tree. VERIFY THIS TEMPLATE ONCE with `route.py doctor` -- codex flag syntax varies by version, and this one line is the only thing that needs changing.

unified._comment: Cursor or any harness where every model is spawnable natively. The router emits a spawn directive; the harness's own subagent mechanism executes it.

claude-native._comment: Fallback preset with zero external dependencies: the Agent tool with a model override. Real tiering, Claude-only models.
